create_ReAgentLightningModule_subclass: create a subclass of ReAgentLightningModule and implement train_step_gen as a generator yielding losses per optimizer
implement_train_step_gen: implement train_step_gen to yield one loss tensor per optimizer for multi-optimizer training in ReAgent
use_StoppingEpochCallback: use StoppingEpochCallback to control incremental training epochs without manually tracking max_epochs across checkpoints
use_set_reporter: call set_reporter on a ReAgentLightningModule instance to configure the experiment logger for training metrics
check_has_test_step_override: check if a ReAgentLightningModule subclass has overridden test_step using the has_test_step_override utility function
